overview: Whiforla II is a star system in the Colonies, within the Zuma Sector, at galactic grid H-9, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Whiforla II appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Colonies.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Whiforla II's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Whiforla II is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Colonies chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Colonies sector records
